about: smock's provisional performance targets, from spec #1, which bench/bench.py checks on every run. They are revisited after the first runs on the real path: changing one is a change to this file alone. A latency target holds for one case of bench/plan.json under one CPU limit at one rate; a run that did not run that case at that rate does not measure it, and one whose requests failed misses it. metric is p50, p90, p99, p99_9 or max (unit ms) or idle_rss (unit MiB).
